title: Listen: U2’s 50th Anniversary Concert at Mount Temple | SiriusXM
summary: Hear U2 revisit their roots with a special 50th anniversary performance at Mount Temple in Dublin.
body_markdown:
[U2](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/u2) went back to school for a milestone performance.


Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton, and Larry Mullen Jr. returned to the Mount Temple Comprehensive School in Dublin, Ireland, on September 25, in honor of their 50th anniversary, for a live show that debuted on SiriusXM’s[U2 X-Radio (Ch. 32)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/u2x-radio) .


[U2: Live at Mount Temple A 50th anniversary concert where it all began Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/U2MountTempleU2XRadio)


Five decades after the band formed in 1976, they surprised fans and current students at Mount Temple with a performance of some of their classics, including “Vertigo,” “Beautiful Day,” and “One.”


- **Related:[Listen to U2’s Final Sphere Show Anytime on U2 X-Radio](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/u2-sphere-concert)**


U2 also delivered the first live performance of their new single “Silencio,” from their upcoming album *Carnaval de Luz* , out November 13. Closing out the show with an encore for the crowd, U2 played a new arrangement of their 1987 hit “With or Without You.”


Listen to *U2: Live at Mount Temple* now on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/U2MountTempleU2XRadio) . Plus, tune in to the concert on SiriusXM U2 X-Radio (Ch. 32) throughout the week.


### About U2 X-Radio


SiriusXM’s U2 X-Radio immerses listeners in the world of U2, featuring the band’s music, history, influences, inspirations, conversations, and more — all curated by U2.
